liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Truckin** (3 reviews): The jam out of Truckin' sits firmly in the early-1973 jazz-leaning style; Truckin' into Eyes of the World is singled out as pretty decent, alongside Playin', China Rider and Greatest Story [4][10][12]
- **Cumberland Blues** (1 review): Reviewer calls this Cumberland Blues epic, with energy that survives the somewhat muddy audience mix [7]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China Cat into Rider has a lovely transition jam with a feel reminiscent of Grooveyes [4]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Reviewer first heard Eyes of the World here, before the studio version had been released [8]

## The recordings

- **gd73-03-30.sbd-aud.cotsman.11616.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 164 min; rated 3.33/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience portion is sketchy; from Playin' onward the recording is clean soundboard, so reviewer kept only that part; Soundboard portion starts at Playin' in the Band; Only an audience-sounding, somewhat muddied recording is available; no soundboard of the show circulates, per reviewer [4][6][7][10][12]
- **gd1973-03-30.154328.aud-composite.flac1644**: audience recording; 25 songs; 161 min [2]. Said about its sound: The first source was remixed slightly and now sounds somewhat better, though results may vary [2]
- **gd1973-03-30.150984.sbd.latvala-eaton-miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 11 songs; 95 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [3]. Said about its sound: A loud hum was removed; a slight buzz remains but is inaudible during the music [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the keyboard playing here is among the hottest of 1973 [5]
- Reviewer counts the second half among their favorite stretches of 1973 shows [6]
- Reviewer calls it a typically good upstate show, similar to the following night's [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-03-30.sbd-aud.cotsman.11616.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard and Audience composite [1]. Also: Disc 1 comes from an audience source; the rest is soundboard, via a matrix transfer chain; Circulated via Paul Hartman and Michael Dixon, then seeded to etree by J. Cotsman [1]
- **gd1973-03-30.154328.aud-composite.flac1644**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Compilation assemembled & transferred by Andrew F. 11/2021; source: Source: Unknown mono AUD, composite source, see notes below. [2]. Also: Composite of two sources: first covers Promised Land through Bird Song, second covers Playin' in the Band to the end; Source tape was rescued from an eBay purchase, thanks to John Petrunis [2]
- **gd1973-03-30.150984.sbd.latvala-eaton-miller.flac1644**: taped by Rob Eaton and Dick Latvala; transferred by Original Transfers and Mastering by Rob Eaton Additional Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 1, 2020; source: SBD > Reel Master (10in 7.5ips 1/2trk) > Apogee AD-500 > DAT (Panasonic SV-3700/48k) [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Bob Morris Grateful Dead: [1973-03-30 Rochester Community War Memorial, Rochester, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1973-03-30-rochester-community-war-memorial-rochester-ny-usa/) [17]
